title: ctenitis poolii
intro: Ctenitis poolii, commonly known as the Pool's ctenitis, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis poolii include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and modulate the immune system, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
